text: कल सुबह 9 बजे तक रिपोर्ट भेज देना, क्लाइंट को 11 बजे दिखानी है।
reference: Please send the report by 9 tomorrow morning, it has to be shown to the client at 11.

text: माँ की तबीयत ठीक नहीं है, इसलिए मैं इस हफ़्ते घर जा रहा हूँ। सोमवार से फिर ऑफिस आऊँगा।
reference: My mother is not well, so I am going home this week. I will be back in the office from Monday.

text: इस महीने का किराया ₹18,000 है, जो 5 तारीख तक जमा करना होगा। देर होने पर ₹500 जुर्माना लगेगा।
reference: This month's rent is ₹18,000 and must be paid by the 5th. A late fee of ₹500 will be charged.

text: Bhai kal match dekhne chalega? Tickets maine book kar liye hain, 7 baje start hai.
reference: Bro, do you want to come watch the match tomorrow? I've booked the tickets, it starts at 7.

text: Sir, aaj network issue ki wajah se main call join nahi kar paya. Recording bhej denge kya?
reference: Sir, I couldn't join the call today because of a network issue. Could you send the recording?

text: Kal se office 10 baje khulega, sab log time pe aana.
reference: कल से ऑफिस 10 बजे खुलेगा, सब लोग समय पर आना।
